name: a-cross-profile-switch-keeps-the-incoming-tiles-icons
description: Two spaces on two profiles, each with favourites on real origins. Both profiles visit their own space first, so each icon cache holds its own tiles. Back on Personal, the BPX pane beside it must already show BPX's icons from BPX's own cache. Cmd+2 then lands on BPX: the pinned grid must take over the very img nodes that the pane loaded. A fresh img shows the letter plate until it loads, and that was the blink on every cross-profile switch.
